Aiden is reviewing the specifications of a computer.
(a)

Aiden thinks adding more RAM capacity to a computer will result in a smoother user experience.
(i)
Explain why this is not necessarily true.  (1 mark)

(1 mark)

(c)

For each of the following system components, suggest a way to conserve power usage from a system configuration viewpoint.
(i)
Graphics processing unit(1 mark)

Secondary storage device(1 mark)
___________________________________________________________________________
(iii)
Central Processing Unit(1 mark)
___________________________________________________________________________
(d)
Below shows a list of common computer problems. Suggest a way to solve them without violating the given constraint.
(i)
The hard drive is full. (Constraint: All files must be preserved for later use; cannot add a new hard drive.)(1 mark)
___________________________________________________________________________
(ii)
The computer takes a long time to boot up.
(Constraint: Upgrade one component only)(1 mark)
___________________________________________________________________________
[--Answer:
(a) (i) A faster clock speed allows more clock cycles/instructions to be executed in the same time period.
(a)(ii) More processing cores allow more instructions to be executed in parallel.
(a)(iii) A larger cache allows more frequently used data to be stored there, reducing data transfer time between CPU and RAM.
(b)(i) Adding more RAM does not improve performance unless there is insufficient RAM capacity and currently using files are paged to the SSD/Hard drive.
(b)(ii) A user has many programs running in the background / A user opens many tabs in the browser / A user is running a computationally heavy program which requires a lot of memory capacity.
(b)(iii) Faster RAM reduces the time needed for transferring data between RAM and CPU/other components.
(c)(i) Use integrated graphics instead of discrete graphics
(c)(ii) Use SSD instead of hard drive
(c)(iii) Use CPU with less number of core / Use low-power CPU
(d)(i) Compress unused files
(d)(ii) Upgrade to an SSD / Add more RAM
--]
